# Crunchyroll fixtures

Synthetic, reduced HTML fixtures model JSON-LD, graph references, localized watch URLs,
malformed scripts, recommendations and season numbering. These are NOT captured
production pages and do not certify today's logged-in player DOM. Titles/IDs are
invented. No cookies, account data, media URLs or paid content are included.

Before store submission, perform the live smoke in docs/CHROME-WEB-STORE.md. If
capturing a regression, retain only public metadata and DOM structure; remove
tokens, cookies, account identifiers, signed URLs and playback content. Record
capture date, locale, route and expected safe/blocked behavior here.
